title: Wrong Access VLAN
symptoms: PC cannot ping its default gateway
user_report: My computer has an IP address but cannot access the network
relevant_config: interface Fa0/10 | switchport mode access | switchport access vlan 20
expected_behavior: PC should be assigned to VLAN 10
root_cause: Access port is assigned to VLAN 20 instead of VLAN 10
correct_fix: Configure Fa0/10 as an access port in VLAN 10

title: VLAN Not Created
symptoms: PC cannot communicate with other devices in the same VLAN
user_report: The VLAN is configured on the port but communication fails
relevant_config: interface Fa0/10 | switchport mode access | switchport access vlan 30
expected_behavior: VLAN 30 should exist on the switch
correct_fix: Create VLAN 30 and assign the required access port

title: Trunk Not Configured
symptoms: Devices in the same VLAN on different switches cannot communicate
user_report: The two switches are connected but VLAN traffic is not passing
expected_behavior: The inter-switch link should carry multiple VLANs
root_cause: Inter-switch connection is configured as an access port instead of a trunk
correct_fix: Configure the inter-switch link as a trunk

title: VLAN Missing From Allowed Trunk
symptoms: VLAN 20 devices cannot communicate across switches
user_report: Other VLANs work but VLAN 20 does not
relevant_config: interface Gi0/1 | switchport mode trunk | switchport trunk allowed vlan 10
expected_behavior: VLAN 20 should be carried across the trunk
root_cause: VLAN 20 is missing from the allowed VLAN list

title: Native VLAN Mismatch
symptoms: Trunk link reports native VLAN mismatch
relevant_config: SW1 native VLAN 10 | SW2 native VLAN 20
expected_behavior: Both trunk interfaces should use the same native VLAN
root_cause: Native VLAN values do not match
correct_fix: Configure the same native VLAN on both trunk interfaces
